summary: Oncotelic Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with Pacific Pier Capital II, LP, issuing a $178,410 convertible promissory note with a 12% original issue discount and 12% interest, convertible at the lower of $0.06/share or 85% of the lowest traded price over ten days. No special-situation catalyst is present; the filing describes a routine financing arrangement with a private investor, not a strategic transaction, activist campaign, or restructuring. What to watch: the variable conversion price and commitment shares create potential dilution, but no event-driven arbitrage angle exists.
